2. Dashboard Usage Guide
2.2 Components by Page > ADMIN > Approvals
Dashboard Screen Feature Guide
Review pending user registration, DICT, and rejection requests in one place.
1 Request Type
Select All or a request type to filter the list. The number beside each tab shows the
pending request count.
2 Review and Decision
Click Review to open a rejection request. For requests with decision buttons, click Approve
to accept or Deny to reject the request.

1. About dashboard
1.3 Access > Registration & Login
Registration & Login Screen Access Details
1 Register
User must create a valid account through the Register tab.
* If you are already registered, you do not need to register again.
Please go to the Login tab and log in with your EP ID
(Initial password: 123456)
- Click the “Register” tab on the login page.
- Type your email address (ID) and password.
- Password must contain at least 8 characters.
- Submit the registration request.
2 Login
- Log in using your registered email and password.
- If login fails, check your account permission.
